author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.102 shipped: Envoy status no longer stuck on stale
summary: Envoy status no longer stuck on stale
why: The Envoy firmware puts its lifetime consumption counter (34,412 kWh) on the consumption-today sensor. URA's hourly cross-check compared that to its own daily total, saw a 99.7 percent gap, and held envoy_status on stale for weeks although every reading was fresh. Skipping lifetime-scale readings removes a false alarm without hiding real divergence.
implications: Shipped ENVOY-FLAKINESS-181243-1 at v5.103.102; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.102.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If Enphase fixes the today counter, the guard becomes inert; no removal needed.

refs.release_notes: The Envoy reports its lifetime counter on the consumption-today sensor; the hourly cross-check now ignores that impossible reading instead of marking the Envoy stale.
